description: Remove a previously-imported Pathrule pattern bundle in one call — the reverse of pathrule_import_pattern. The pattern definition is the manifest, so this finds and deletes the memories/rules/skills whose titles match the pattern's pieces. Pass the SAME `node_path` base used at import (omit if the pattern's own paths were used). Pieces not found are reported, not errors (idempotent). Relay the returned human_message.

node_path.description: The base path the bundle was imported under. Must match the import to locate the pieces.

slug.description: Pattern slug — the part after 'package:' in ::pathrule:package:<slug>.

verbose.description: Set true for per-piece detail. Default false (compact summary).

name: pathrule_remove_pattern

outputSchema.description: Compact form by default. With verbose=true the full removal record is spread onto the top level instead.

error.description: Present only when ok is false.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure code, for example insufficient_scope, workspace_id_required, rate_limited, not_found, or upstream_error. Branch on this, not on message text.

detail.description: Optional structured context for the failure, for example { missing_scopes: [...] } on insufficient_scope.

human_message.description: One-line summary of the result, safe to relay to the user verbatim.

not_found.description: Pieces the bundle declares that were not present under the given node_path.

ok.description: true when the call succeeded. false when it did not, in which case `error` carries the reason and the success fields are absent.

removed.description: The pieces actually deleted, grouped by kind.

title: Pathrule Remove Pattern
